question: What is the meaning of material quality certification in relation to certifications, standards, classifications and compliance, legal and regulatory information?
data_group: certifications, standards, classifications and compliance, legal and regulatory information
description: Material quality certification ensures that the quality of a building is verified by an objective third-party, allowing for objective comparisons between buildings. It serves as a marketing tool and can be linked to various building certification systems. Material quality certification is part of the assessment and certification process that involves different systems used worldwide with various characteristics and focal areas.
